three-mesh-bvh + three-bvh-csg — vendored locally so the boolean cut/merge
feature loads same-origin (lazy-loaded only when that panel opens).
Source unmodified. License: MIT.
https://github.com/gkjohnson/three-mesh-bvh
https://github.com/gkjohnson/three-bvh-csg

Loaded as classic global (UMD) scripts, not ES modules, because their npm
ESM builds import from sibling source files (not a flat bundle); the UMD
build is the only flat, self-contained bundle available. They expect
window.THREE (set from our own ESM `import * as THREE from 'three'`) to
already exist before they load; three-mesh-bvh sets window.MeshBVHLib,
then three-bvh-csg reads that and sets window.ThreBvhCsg.
